{"ok":true,"data":{"schema":"manus.game.blueprint.continuation/v1","state":{"gameEngine":"threejs","schema":"manus.game.blueprint/v1","blueprintId":"gbp_34d1d37b0f4fcddfd3a6aa04","name":"yejing","title":"烬野：暗影回响","notificationTransport":"server","description":"基于 GameDev showcase《穴居人大战荒野》及随后接入的完整原始源码与素材 ZIP，创建一个新的 3D 游戏重制版《烬野：暗影回响》。保留原示例的核心玩法、可玩流程与项目既有 Three.js 运行环境，在其基础上将美术表现方向调整为受《暗黑破坏神》系列启发的暗黑奇幻动作 RPG 氛围：阴郁、压迫、粗粝且具有强烈明暗对比；这是风格参考，不使用暗黑破坏神的专有角色、标识、剧情或受版权保护素材，也不暗示官方关联。先评估在现有源代码、资产及运行时约束下可行的改造范围，再以实际可用、能运行的方式完成重制；优先利用原项目结构及资源，把风格改造落实到场景观感、色彩与光照、敌人与环境表现、战斗反馈和界面视觉中，不以风格描述替代可玩成品。保持项目与其现有运行时兼容。游戏内容语言为简体中文。","language":"zh-CN","revision":4,"phase":"initialized","visualDimension":"3d","summary":"你将基于《穴居人大战荒野》及其完整源码与素材 ZIP，在既有 Three.js 环境中重制《烬野：暗影回响》，保留核心玩法与完整可玩流程，并在运行时约束内实现原创、可运行的暗黑奇幻动作 RPG 氛围。","choices":{"genre":"3D 暗黑奇幻动作 RPG 重制版","gameplay":"保留原示例的核心玩法、可玩流程及现有运行时兼容性；先评估源码、资产与运行时约束下的可行改造范围，再完成实际可运行的重制。
优先沿用原项目结构和资源，将阴郁、压迫、粗粝且强明暗对比的暗黑奇幻风格落实到场景观感、色彩、光照与环境表现中。
重塑敌人与战斗呈现，强化命中、受击等战斗反馈，使整体体验符合暗黑奇幻动作 RPG 氛围，而非仅停留在风格描述。
统一改造界面视觉，并确保游戏内容使用简体中文。
仅将《暗黑破坏神》系列作为风格参考；不使用其专有角色、标识、剧情或受版权保护素材，也不暗示任何官方关联。","assetProduction":"ai_generated_max","onlineFeatures":[],"riggingAndAnimation":true},"gameStarter":"3d-generic","unresolved":[],"projectInitialized":true,"resourceUri":"manus-resource://manus-webdev/project/wdp_0ec58af7700563ecb0a07238","approvedRevision":4},"nextAction":"implement","allowedActions":["refresh","update"],"persistentPresentation":true,"splitPresentation":true},"instruction":"The Three.js Blueprint is approved. Continue the existing Three.js project with its approved gameplay. Use the normal Web build, Git/checkpoint and deployment flow. For requested online multiplayer, read game-multiplayer.md and follow its published-URL acceptance requirements. Follow the saved 3D model generation choice under game-blueprint.md#threejs-blueprint before sourcing or generating models. Preserve narrower restrictions and historical explicit permissions when no choice is saved. Do not initialize again or enter Godot preparation or its concept-review flow. The saved asset choice requests generation for the initial implementation of this approved Blueprint only. Generate and integrate the 3D models needed for the approved gameplay while keeping suitable existing assets. Follow game-threejs-assets.md for generation entry-point selection, billing disclosure, capability checks and project asset import. During that initial implementation, this approved choice supersedes older commentary saying generation is undecided; do not ask for the same generation approval again. Preserve actual supplied-only, no-AI, budget and style restrictions; separately approve generated audio. If restrictions, runtime capability or tool failure prevent generation, explain the blocker instead of silently delivering procedural replacements. For later modifications, generate models only when the current request explicitly authorizes those models; unrelated edits or generic visual improvements do not authorize generation. Existing procedural or generated assets are not an unfinished generation backlog; preserve them unless the current request authorizes replacement. Do not retry earlier blocked generation during unrelated work. The saved riggingAndAnimation choice is Yes for the initial implementation of this approved Blueprint only. Follow game-blueprint.md#threejs-character-rigging-and-animation: reuse suitable rigs and baked clips first, then call rig_3d_model or animate_3d_model only for missing character work. For later modifications, rig or animate only when the current request explicitly authorizes it. The saved Blueprint selects no online integrations; do not add Manus login, an online leaderboard or Stripe from superseded brief text. Keep a new Game static with server/database disabled. Preserve already provisioned infrastructure when revising an existing project. If the user later explicitly changes this game's direction, gameplay or production choices, read game-blueprint-update.md unless already in context, then send POST game/blueprint/update with expectedRevision 4, or the revision from your latest update reply, in the same parallel tool call as your first edit for that change. state.name: yejing
state.title: 烬野：暗影回响
state.description: 基于 GameDev showcase《穴居人大战荒野》及随后接入的完整原始源码与素材 ZIP，创建一个新的 3D 游戏重制版《烬野：暗影回响》。保留原示例的核心玩法、可玩流程与项目既有 Three.js 运行环境，在其基础上将美术表现方向调整为受《暗黑破坏神》系列启发的暗黑奇幻动作 RPG 氛围：阴郁、压迫、粗粝且具有强烈明暗对比；这是风格参考，不使用暗黑破坏神的专有角色、标识、剧情或受版权保护素材，也不暗示官方关联。先评估在现有源代码、资产及运行时约束下可行的改造范围，再以实际可用、能运行的方式完成重制；优先利用原项目结构及资源，把风格改造落实到场景观感、色彩与光照、敌人与环境表现、战斗反馈和界面视觉中，不以风格描述替代可玩成品。保持项目与其现有运行时兼容。游戏内容语言为简体中文。
state.summary: 你将基于《穴居人大战荒野》及其完整源码与素材 ZIP，在既有 Three.js 环境中重制《烬野：暗影回响》，保留核心玩法与完整可玩流程，并在运行时约束内实现原创、可运行的暗黑奇幻动作 RPG 氛围。

choices.genre: 3D 暗黑奇幻动作 RPG 重制版
choices.gameplay:
保留原示例的核心玩法、可玩流程及现有运行时兼容性；先评估源码、资产与运行时约束下的可行改造范围，再完成实际可运行的重制。
优先沿用原项目结构和资源，将阴郁、压迫、粗粝且强明暗对比的暗黑奇幻风格落实到场景观感、色彩、光照与环境表现中。
重塑敌人与战斗呈现，强化命中、受击等战斗反馈，使整体体验符合暗黑奇幻动作 RPG 氛围，而非仅停留在风格描述。
统一改造界面视觉，并确保游戏内容使用简体中文。
仅将《暗黑破坏神》系列作为风格参考；不使用其专有角色、标识、剧情或受版权保护素材，也不暗示任何官方关联。

structuredContent.instruction: The Three.js Blueprint is approved. Continue the existing Three.js project with its approved gameplay. Use the normal Web build, Git/checkpoint and deployment flow. For requested online multiplayer, read game-multiplayer.md and follow its published-URL acceptance requirements. Follow the saved 3D model generation choice under game-blueprint.md#threejs-blueprint before sourcing or generating models. Preserve narrower restrictions and historical explicit permissions when no choice is saved. Do not initialize again or enter Godot preparation or its concept-review flow. The saved asset choice requests generation for the initial implementation of this approved Blueprint only. Generate and integrate the 3D models needed for the approved gameplay while keeping suitable existing assets. Follow game-threejs-assets.md for generation entry-point selection, billing disclosure, capability checks and project asset import. During that initial implementation, this approved choice supersedes older commentary saying generation is undecided; do not ask for the same generation approval again. Preserve actual supplied-only, no-AI, budget and style restrictions; separately approve generated audio. If restrictions, runtime capability or tool failure prevent generation, explain the blocker instead of silently delivering procedural replacements. For later modifications, generate models only when the current request explicitly authorizes those models; unrelated edits or generic visual improvements do not authorize generation. Existing procedural or generated assets are not an unfinished generation backlog; preserve them unless the current request authorizes replacement. Do not retry earlier blocked generation during unrelated work. The saved riggingAndAnimation choice is Yes for the initial implementation of this approved Blueprint only. Follow game-blueprint.md#threejs-character-rigging-and-animation: reuse suitable rigs and baked clips first, then call rig_3d_model or animate_3d_model only for missing character work. For later modifications, rig or animate only when the current request explicitly authorizes it. The saved Blueprint selects no online integrations; do not add Manus login, an online leaderboard or Stripe from superseded brief text. Keep a new Game static with server/database disabled. Preserve already provisioned infrastructure when revising an existing project. If the user later explicitly changes this game's direction, gameplay or production choices, read game-blueprint-update.md unless already in context, then send POST game/blueprint/update with expectedRevision 4, or the revision from your latest update reply, in the same parallel tool call as your first edit for that change. Bug fixes, polish and edits inside the saved scope need no update.
